name: spatial-camera-suite
title: Spatial Camera Suite
description: A theme-aware spatial interface stage with five seekable camera shot recipes: low graze, depth parallax, hero spotlight, runway drop, and steep glide.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: Use a scene-relevant spatial shotStyle. `items` is up to three pipe-separated `label::detail` pairs; prefix exactly one featured label with `*` for spotlight focus. Supply a project-local imageUrl only when real visual evidence is needed. All five shot styles are complete deterministic camera recipes inside one shared stage; do not add another camera transform to this scene.
